findings.source_quote: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess. Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also –Matthew 23:25-26.
findings.suggested_fix: Modernize the register of all Scripture quotations to contemporary Modern Greek while preserving meaning and all chapter/verse identifiers and HTML structure. Avoid Koine/archaic inflections (e.g., replace «Ουαί σε σας» with «Ουαί σε σας» could be retained as a literary device, but prefer clearer modern phrasing such as «Ουαί σε σας, γραμματείς και Φαρισαίοι, υποκριτές!» only if it reads naturally; however prefer modern verbs and pronouns where possible). Do this consistently in every <blockquote> that contains Scripture. Leave the tags and reference markers unchanged.
findings.translation_quote: Ουαί σε σας, γραμματείες και Φαρισαίοι υποκριταί! διότι καθαρίζετε το εξωτερικό του ποτηρίου και του δίσκου, ενώ μέσα αυτά είναι γεμάτα εκμετάλλευση και υπερβολή. Ω τυφλέ Φαρισαίε, καθάρισον πρώτον το εντός του ποτηρίου και του δίσκου, ώστε να καθαρισθεί και το έξω αυτών –Ματθαίος 23:25-26.

findings.source_quote: What a foolish thing it would be for a man to wash only the outside of a cup, which is to be looked at, and to leave the inside dirty, which is to be used.

Make these wording updates while preserving the author’s theological meaning and keeping the original HTML tags and structure intact. No structural changes to paragraphs or quoted Scripture placement.
